meta.title: Vendor Self-Service Invoice Submission Portal: refused for a user without the Vendor role
gaps: Navigate to and submit an invoice through the Vendor Self-Service Invoice Submission Portal
Sign in as a user without the Vendor role and verify the portal is refused or absent
Repeat the comparison by signing in as a Vendor on the same Enterprise tenant
Verify the tenant is on the Enterprise plan and record any deliberate RBAC grant to other roles
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Navigate to and submit an invoice through the Vendor Self-Service Invoice Submission Portal; Sign in as a user without the Vendor role and verify the portal is refused or absent; Repeat the comparison by signing in as a Vendor on the same Enterprise tenant; Verify the tenant is on the Enterprise plan and record any deliberate RBAC grant to other roles

args.need: sign in on the same Enterprise tenant as a non-Vendor user and as a Vendor, open the Vendor Self-Service Invoice Submission Portal, attempt invoice submission in both sessions, and report whether access is refused or available

steps.note: The required role-specific portal and alternate-user sessions are not available in the catalog.
Ensure the session left by the tester has no visible crash or server error, without claiming that invoice access was tested.
